commands.command:
cat > /usr/local/bin/inventory-agent.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Minimal inventory application: emits periodic stock-level log events.
items="widget-a widget-b widget-c gadget-x gadget-y"
i=0
while true; do
  item=$(echo "$items" | tr ' ' '\n' | sed -n "$(( (i % 5) + 1 ))p")
  qty=$(( (i * 7) % 100 ))
  logger -t inventory -p local0.info "item=${item} qty=${qty} event=stock_update"
  i=$(( i + 1 ))
  sleep 5
done
EOF
chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/inventory-agent.sh
cat /usr/local/bin/inventory-agent.sh
